## About
Marcel's is a family owned auto body, paint and collision shop in Miami. Marcel and his wife Ana run it together, and they help you from the first call to the day you pick up your car.
Not all collisions or projects are equal, but we give the same care from simple paint matching to full structural and body repair. We take the time to bring your vehicle back to its pre-accident condition, and we stand behind all our repairs. All makes and models are welcome.
We accept all insurance companies, and we work for you. Our customers rate us 4.9 on Google from 63 reviews.

## Services
- Free Estimates: Call us to make an appointment, or email us your contact info, vehicle info and photos.
- Free Towing: Free towing to our facility with repair, within Miami-Dade County.
- Rental Car Assistance: We can help set up a rental for you, and you'll be conveniently picked up right here at our facility.
- Heavy Collision Repair: Full structural and body repair to bring your vehicle back to its pre-accident condition.
- Auto Body Repairs: From simple paint matching to body repair, with the same care and attention on every job.
- Paintless Dent Removal

## FAQ
Q: Do you accept my insurance company?
A: Yes. We accept all insurance companies and understand their procedures, so your car comes back to you in its pre-accident condition in a timely manner.

Q: What forms of payment are accepted?
A: We accept Visa, Mastercard, VENMO and insurance checks.

Q: I need a tow truck, can you help me?
A: Yes. Give us a call and we can set up a tow truck to pick up your car at no charge to you, within Miami-Dade County. Tow companies not set up by us or by you may take your car somewhere that leads to unnecessary fees.

Q: Can I choose the repair shop?
A: Yes. You have the right to choose the facility that repairs your vehicle. Don't let anyone steer you to a shop that serves their interest instead of yours.

Q: I was involved in an accident, what should I do next?
A: First, call all the necessary authorities. Don't drive a car that could be dangerous after a collision. Call us and we can arrange a tow with minimal wait time.
